thread:
anya: Hey team — first day! My new M2 MBP arrived but Kandji enrollment is stuck on 'Waiting for ABM activation'. FileVault never prompted and I can't install Homebrew (permission denied). Anyone run into this after the ABM migration?

lucas: welcome :) can you paste the output of `profiles status` and `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial`? also what's the serial so i can check ABM assignment?

anya: serial: C02ZQ0YQJ1CG
profiles status output: No enrolled MDM profile found.

it-bot: Ticket INC-2345 created and assigned to emily-it for device enrollment issues. Link: https://internal.redwood/support/INC-2345

emily-it: hi @anya — i grabbed the ticket. quick checklist: 1) did you sign into the company wifi + okta sso? 2) can you try the Kandji status command: `sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-enroll --status` (no token needed for status). post result here.

anya: ran it, output: "Not enrolled — waiting for assignment"

lucas: sounds like the device wasn't assigned in Apple Business Manager to the Kandji server during the ABM move. i'm checking ABM now.

devex-dave: if we need to get you unblocked immediately for dev work, i can issue a 1-hour local admin grant. submit the one-time admin form: https://internal.redwood/devex/admin-request and paste the request id here. otherwise we should fix ABM mapping so FileVault enrolls automatically.

anya: submitted form, request id ADM-7821

emily-it: thanks — i've manually assigned the serial in Kandji and triggered an enrollment push from the console. try rebooting and then run `profiles status` again.

lucas: FYI for the team — during the ABM tenant migration some devices needed to be re-assigned to the new MDM server, so expect a handful of these. we should add a short KB.

anya: rebooted, then ran `profiles status` — now shows "MDM: Kandji (managed)". FileVault prompt popped up during first login, set recovery key. Everything else looks good. :tada:

emily-it: awesome — marking INC-2345 resolved. devex-dave your admin grant queued?

devex-dave: admin request ADM-7821 completed, 1 hour sudo activated. i'll add a short note to onboarding checklist about checking ABM assignment when imaging new macs.

anya: thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick help. tagging this to the onboarding thread for next hires.

emily-it: welcome to Redwood! ping us if anything else comes up.
